html:
A civil war in Guinea-Bissau from June 1998 to May 1999, between President Nino Vieira and the army under his dismissed chief of staff Ansumane Mane.

Vieira had sacked Mane over claims that the army sold arms to rebels in the Casamance region of Senegal. Most of the army sided with Mane. Senegal and Guinea sent troops to help Vieira, and fighting emptied much of Bissau; hundreds of thousands fled. A peace deal brought in a small West African force, but fighting resumed and the rebels won in May 1999, sending Vieira into exile. The war left the state weak and the army powerful.
sum: A civil war in Guinea-Bissau from June 1998 to May 1999, between President Nino Vieira and the army under his dismissed chief of staff Ansumane Mane.
